title: Provision Food Factory Sim - Free Play Mode
author: InformationTop5376
selftext:
Provision is a factory sim about building food-production lines while changing market rules force you to rethink them. I’ve just added a finite supply-contract system for the free play mode (there’s a tutorial too), and I’d love feedback on whether buying stock, enabling Auto, and choosing family expansions makes sense in their current state.

Play: https://waypost-studios.itch.io/provision

Some questions I’d like to know the answers to  
\- Does the Supply drawer make sense without additional explanation?  
\- Does Buy versus Auto feel like a meaningful choice?  
\- Do the limited family expansions make you prioritize particular production lines?  
\- Does managing supply add useful planning, or does it feel like busywork?  
\- When did money or raw materials meaningfully constrain a decision?

If possible, tell me which session you reached and roughly how much cash you had.

Thanks for any assistance in playtesting this. I’m inching closer and closer to a commercial demo, and hoping to close some of the gaps here.

replies.author: InformationTop5376
replies.body: Visually it could be comparable, but focus is more on responding to changing food regulations and supply chain management.
